resolved_findings.finding: Owned descendants could survive normal/failed/killed leader exit and escape final CPU accounting.
resolved_findings.resolution: Subreaper plus live group CPU accounting; unconditional SIGKILL/reap and group-exit verification on normal and exceptional leader exit.
independent_cases: exception after each of those leader exits

resolved_findings.resolution: Resume rejects cleanup_error and verifies prior monitor/worker identities and owned groups are absent.
